editionData.description: Global headlines: U.S. withdraws forces in Iraq as balance of power shifts to Iran (U.S. military forces are set to depart from bases in Iraq on Wednesday, a milestone in two bloody decades of American involvement); Investigators announce break in Mexico’s most notorious unsolved crime (Officials say searches of two funeral parlors have shined new light on the 2014 disappearance of 43 college students in southern Mexico); and Morocco appoints its first female prime minister (A royal decree issued by Morocco’s King Muhammed VI tasked Fatima Zahra El Mansouri with forming a new cabinet, probably a coalition government with other political groups). Markets leaned higher, with 4 of 7 tracked indexes up; Nikkei 225 up 1.94% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Livenerf: Has Opus 5.5 been nerfed yet? (Benchmark for tracking model capability after release. - ninjahawk/livenerf); Solving Factorio Quality (I play Factorio the normal way: by writing matrix math code to plan the factory); and Dots: Always-on agents (Dots by OpenAI are proactive assistants that can keep working across complex projects and everyday tasks. Learn how dots help you stay in...). headlines.title: U.S. withdraws forces in Iraq as balance of power shifts to Iran
headlines.summary: U.S. military forces are set to depart from bases in Iraq on Wednesday, a milestone in two bloody decades of American involvement.

headlines.title: Investigators announce break in Mexico’s most notorious unsolved crime
headlines.summary: Officials say searches of two funeral parlors have shined new light on the 2014 disappearance of 43 college students in southern Mexico.

headlines.title: Morocco appoints its first female prime minister
headlines.summary: A royal decree issued by Morocco’s King Muhammed VI tasked Fatima Zahra El Mansouri with forming a new cabinet, probably a coalition government with other political groups.

headlines.title: Trump official central to deportation deals tapped for ambassadorship
headlines.summary: Christian Ehrhardt, who negotiated the administration’s controversial “third country” agreements, is the White House pick for ambassador to Cameroon.

headlines.title: Trump’s proposed diesel export ban spurs fear of energy crunch in Europe
headlines.summary: The European Union's energy commissioner sent a letter to the bloc's 27 member states recommending that they all cut gas and electricity consumption “for as long as necessary.”

headlines.title: Trump says Iran war will wrap up ‘very soon’ but shares no details
headlines.summary: US President Donald Trump reiterates that Tehran will not have a nuclear weapon.

headlines.title: Israel’s Lapid accuses Netanyahu of ‘fear-mongering’ over attack warning
headlines.summary: Opposition leader dismisses Netanyahu's warning of possible attacks during next month's general election.

headlines.title: Public workers in France strike over pay as student protests turn violent
headlines.summary: Tens of thousands of workers march nationwide, as police arrest 440 students in clashes at schools.

headlines.title: Morocco’s pro-Palestine protests challenge Rabat’s deepening Israel ties
headlines.summary: Protests across Morocco highlight gap between public opposition to normalisation and Rabat’s closer ties with Israel.

headlines.title: ‘Nothing is justifying this’: Qatar’s PM slams Israel’s atrocities in Gaza
headlines.summary: Qatar's top diplomat says Israel has undermined Doha's efforts to broker a ceasefire in Gaza from 'day one'.

headlines.title: An 87-year-old woman whose eviction sparked protests in Spain is returning home
headlines.summary: María del Carmen Abascal's case has drawn tens of thousands of people to the streets in recent days and led the Spanish government to present measures to address the country's housing crisis.

headlines.title: Trump says top tech firms have signed accord to 'self-police' AI development
headlines.summary: President Trump on Tuesday said that he and a large group of leaders of artificial intelligence companies had signed a voluntary accord that will include internal and external reviews.

headlines.title: Hurricane Polo's remnants bringing more rain to flood-struck U.S. Southwest
headlines.summary: The storm's remnants battered the U.S. Southwest, flooding roadways and forcing residents in small New Mexico towns to evacuate over concerns about a dam failing.

headlines.title: The federal law aimed at protecting college students from sexual abuse
headlines.summary: The lawsuit by a former Cornell University student, alleging she was raped in 2024 by seven male students, has renewed long-standing concerns about how colleges deal with sexual assault.

headlines.title: U.S. Supreme Court sides with Trump administration in third-country deportations
headlines.summary: The Supreme Court allowed the Trump administration to resume deportations of migrants to countries that are not identified in their removal orders. It also plans to hear full arguments on the case.

headlines.title: Washington blames UK base incident on a 'foreign actor'
headlines.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the "hands of a foreign actor" were involved in an incident in which five men were arrested on suspected explosives and terrorism offenses near a British air base used by US forces.

headlines.title: Chancay Port rides a new trade current
headlines.summary: For Santos Javier Gonzales, the deep-water mega port taking shape in his hometown of Chancay, Peru, has become part of his own story — enabling him to build a career without leaving his family behind.

headlines.title: Landmark Chinese garden takes root in England
headlines.summary: SALFORD, England — After nearly eight years in the making, a Chinese garden that authorities describe as the largest of its kind in Europe has opened in Salford, bringing a distinctive Chinese presence to the horticultural landscape of northern England.

headlines.title: Ukraine's provocations fuel tensions, Putin says
headlines.summary: MOSCOW/KYIV — Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Friday that an escalation of tensions would not achieve the outcome sought by Kyiv and could only worsen the situation in Ukraine.

headlines.title: Beijing urges Japan to honor joint political commitments
headlines.summary: Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun urged the Japanese authorities to seriously reflect on and correct their wrongdoings and take real actions to return to the purpose and mission of the four key political documents shared by China and Japan.

headlines.title: Of those deleted in SIR so far, over 71% in ‘absent, shifted or others’ category
headlines.summary: EC data show over 71% of deletions under SIR are from absent/shifted/other categories, many may reappear on rolls after Form 6.

headlines.title: Sahil Wakode’s parents seek police protection, allege threat to life and probe
headlines.summary: Parents of Sahil Wakode seek police protection, allege threats tied to IIT Bombay professors amid death probe and CCTV concerns.

headlines.title: Terrorist killed in ongoing operation in Kashmir’s Budgam
headlines.summary: One terrorist killed in ongoing joint Army, police, and CRPF operation in Budgam, Kashmir, following specific intelligence input.

headlines.title: M.P. Cabinet approves 20% quota for Agniveers in police, other uniformed services
headlines.summary: MP Cabinet approves 20% Agniveer quota in uniformed services, plus 5% ex-servicemen and 10% home guards reservations, alongside regional development plans.

headlines.title: Congress workers booked for attempt to murder over ‘defacement’ of CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s Agra house
headlines.summary: Congress workers face attempt-to-murder charges over alleged defacement of CEC Gyanesh Kumar's Agra home amid protests, with police citing multiple sections.
